mapper.select: SELECT d.name AS name, count(1) as `value` FROM `wholesaler_questionnaire` a inner join wholesaler_relationship b on a.id = b.business_id inner join space c on b.stall_id = c.id inner join company d on c.company_id=d.id where a.create_time BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end} GROUP BY stall_id

select b.`name` as name, count(1) as `value` from wholesaler_contract a inner join wholesaler_contract_type b on a.contract_type_id = b.id where a.create_time BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end} GROUP BY a.contract_type_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.`name` as deviceName, c.`name` AS companyName, c.`owner`, e.z_score_avg, e.s_score_avg, e.t_score_avg, e.w_score_avg, e.honesty_score FROM company c inner JOIN space s ON s.company_id = c.id left JOIN stall_evaluation e ON s.id = e.stall_id
SELECT #{type} as name, count(1) as `value` FROM stall_evaluation_record c where examine_status = 1 GROUP BY #{type}
select 100 - IFNULL(sum(b.item_result_mark), 0) `name`, count(1) `value` from space a left join stall_safety_insp b on a.id = b.stall_id where a.deleted = false
